title: Boon of the Hag
summary: Drink as a Bonus Action and take 2d6 Poison damage. A failed Constitution save can cause further damage for up to 10 turns.

fields.Effect: Drink as a Bonus Action and take 2d6 Poison damage. Make a DC 15 Constitution save. On a failure, take 2d6 Poison at the start of each turn for up to 10 turns, ending early when a DC 13 Constitution save succeeds.
fields.Base value: 1 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.
